newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Siantar Top stable on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Siantar Top stable on debut.

text.p: Indonesian snack food producer PT Siantar Top rose marginally on its debut on Monday on small volume with overall market sentiment relatively weak, brokers said.
It traded at 2,300 rupiah after touching 2,400 rupiah at the opening, up about 4.5 percent from its offer price of 2,200 rupiah on a volume of 2.8 million shares.
Brokers said the upside appeared to be limited as the price was quite high. They said the market had also slowed with the approach of the Christmas holiday season.
"I think its quite expensive. Some local investors are more interested in some other Initital Public Offering such as Bank Pikko or the listing of Sierad Produce next week," a local broker said.
Another broker said the number of shares offered by PT Siantar Top was relatively small compared to some previous newly-listed companies.
"For small investors who play on the short term, it's not a very liquid stock," she added.
PT Siantar Top offered 27 million shares during its public offer November 29-December 3, with PT Credit Lyonnais Capital Indonesia as the lead underwriter.
